description: How many months of essential spending the Emergency fund calculator's rules point to for a household, the target in pounds, and how many months current savings would cover. Use for 'how big should my emergency fund be'.

currentSavings.description: Cash set aside now, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

dependants.description: People depending on that income, not counting themselves. Defaults to 0.

jobSecurity.description: How secure the income is. Defaults to average.

monthlyEssentials.description: Essential spending a month - housing, bills, food - in pounds.

secondIncome.description: A second income could carry the household alone. Defaults to false.

name: calculate_emergency_fund
title: Emergency fund
